EMISSION-FACTOR REFERENCE, NOT A TECHNOLOGY SOURCE: belongs in source-details_reference.csv (id eccc_2026_001 is free in source-details_reference.csv and source-details_sources.csv). Only STEM_factors.csv is written (columns fuel,sector-or-equipment,gas,factor,unit,heating-value-basis,reference,note). Locators are PRINTED NIR page numbers (526-572) with the table number; the PDF holds Annex 6 only (PDF page = printed page - 525). Values were read from the companion xlsx and checked against the PDF text; xlsx NG values are unrounded floats, the printed integers are used. Loaded: stationary-combustion CO2/CH4/N2O for natural gas (marketable CO2 for Canada and each province for 1990, 2005 and 2024; non-marketable producer gas 2024; CH4/N2O by sector: electric utilities, industrial, producer consumption, pipelines, cement, manufacturing, residential/commercial), NGL, refined petroleum products (light and heavy fuel oil, kerosene, diesel, gasoline by sector), petroleum coke and still gas (2024 CO2, CH4), coal by type and province (CO2 kg/t wet basis, CH4/N2O by sector), coke and coke oven gas, cement-industry waste fuel (2024), biomass and biogas (Tables A6.6-1 and A6.6-2), industrial-process factors (cement clinker, lime, limestone/dolomite, soda ash, ammonia, urea, nitric/adipic acid, petrochemicals, iron and steel, aluminium, magnesium, rare earths, non-energy use). Not loaded: other years of the time series (the xlsx holds 1990-2024), Table A6.1-5 provincial producer-consumption CH4, A6.1-13 coal-mining fugitives, A6.1-15 mobile sources, A6.2-12 to A6.2-14 (electronics, HFC/PFC), A6.3 (N2O use, urea in SCR), A6.4 agriculture, A6.5 LULUCF, A6.7 waste. HEATING VALUES: the Annex prints NO energy-content (HHV/LHV) table; factors are per physical unit (g/m3, g/L, kg/t), so heating-value-basis is not applicable; per-GJ conversion needs Statistics Canada RESD energy contents. Only HHV figures in the text: wood waste 20.44 MJ/kg (0% moisture) and spent pulping liquor / bio-fuel 13.7 MJ/kg (Tran 2014), used by ECCC to convert kg/GJ data. Traps: (1) Table A6.1-8 (petroleum coke N2O, g/m3) is labelled "Table A6-6" in the xlsx and the unit is printed as g/m3; only 2001-2014 columns are loaded because the xlsx stops there. (2) Table A6.2-6 limestone/dolomite units are printed as "CO2 / kg CaCO3" (g CO2/kg assumed). (3) Ranges are printed ranges with no central value. (4) Biogenic CO2 (wood, liquor, biogas) is a memo item not in inventory totals. (5) Personal-communication footnotes cite CEEDC data (Griffin B., 2025).
